recipes.title: Slow-cooker pulled pork sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Fall-apart pork piled on buns with tangy barbecue sauce

steps.text: Mix the brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Rub it all over the pork.
Put the onion in the slow cooker, set the pork on top, and pour the broth around it.
Cover and cook on low until the pork falls apart easily with a fork.
Move the pork to a cutting board and shred it with two forks. Throw away big pieces of fat.
Pour off most of the liquid. Put the pork back and stir in the barbecue sauce.
Cover and warm on low so the sauce soaks in.
Pile onto buns and top with coleslaw if you like.

recipes.title: Oven baby back ribs
recipes.blurb: Dry-rubbed, slow-baked ribs glazed with sticky barbecue sauce

ingredients.item: racks baby back ribs (about 2 lb each)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 275°F. Pull the thin membrane off the back of each rack and pat the ribs dry.
Mix the sugar, paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper. Rub on both sides.
Wrap each rack tightly in foil and set them on a baking sheet.
Bake until the meat is very tender and pulling back from the bones.
Heat the broiler. Unwrap the ribs, set them on the sheet, and brush with barbecue sauce.
Broil until the sauce bubbles and darkens. Watch closely.
Rest, then cut between the bones and serve with extra sauce.

recipes.title: Oven barbecue beef brisket
recipes.blurb: Tender sliced brisket braised low and slow in a tangy sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 300°F. Mix the paprika, sugar, chili powder, salt and pepper, and rub it over the brisket.
Scatter the onion and garlic in a roasting pan. Set the brisket on top, fat side up, and pour in the broth.
Cover the pan tightly with foil.
Roast until a fork slides into the meat with little resistance.
Rest the brisket on a cutting board, still covered.
Slice across the grain. Stir the barbecue sauce into the pan juices and spoon over the slices.

recipes.title: Grilled barbecue chicken
recipes.blurb: Juicy bone-in chicken grilled and brushed with sweet sauce

steps.text: Heat a grill to medium, with one hot side and one cooler side.
Rub the chicken with oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Grill on the cooler side, covered, turning once, until almost cooked through.
Brush the chicken with barbecue sauce and move it over the hot side.
Grill, turning and brushing, until the sauce is sticky and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes and serve with the leftover sauce.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker BBQ pulled chicken
recipes.blurb: Easy shredded chicken in smoky sauce for sandwiches

steps.text: Mix the sauce, broth, sugar, vinegar, paprika, garlic powder and salt in the slow cooker.
Add the chicken and turn it to coat.
Cover and cook on low until the chicken is 165°F and tender.
Shred the chicken with two forks right in the pot.
Stir it into the sauce and let it soak up the flavor.
Spoon onto buns and serve.

recipes.title: Oven pork belly burnt ends
recipes.blurb: Crispy, sticky, caramelized cubes of pork belly

steps.text: Heat the oven to 275°F. Toss the pork cubes with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Spread on a rack set over a baking sheet.
Bake until the cubes are browned and the fat has started to render.
Move the cubes to a foil pan. Add the sauce, honey and butter and toss to coat.
Cover the pan with foil.
Bake until the pork is very tender.
Uncover and bake until the sauce is thick and sticky.

recipes.title: Grilled BBQ pork chops
recipes.blurb: Thick chops with a quick rub and a sweet sauce glaze

steps.text: Heat a grill to medium-high.
Brush the chops with oil. Mix the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and rub it on.
Grill the chops, flipping once, until nearly done.
Brush both sides with barbecue sauce.
Grill, turning once, until the chops reach 145°F inside.
Rest the chops before serving.

recipes.title: Oven barbecue chicken wings
recipes.blurb: Crispy baked wings tossed in a smoky sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Set a rack over a foil-lined baking sheet and spray it with cooking spray.
Pat the wings very dry. Toss with baking powder, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Spread the wings on the rack in one layer.
Bake, flipping halfway, until crisp and 165°F inside.
Stir the sauce and honey together in a large bowl and toss the hot wings in it.
Return the wings to the rack and bake to set the glaze.

recipes.title: Grilled smoked sausage and peppers
recipes.blurb: Smoky sausage and sweet peppers charred on the grill

steps.text: Heat a grill to medium-high.
Toss the peppers and onion with oil, paprika and salt in a bowl.
Grill the vegetables in a grill basket, stirring now and then, until charred and tender.
Grill the sausage cut side down, then flip, until browned and hot all the way through.
Toast the rolls on the grill for a minute.
Fill the rolls with sausage and vegetables and drizzle with barbecue sauce.

recipes.title: Southern fried chicken
recipes.blurb: Buttermilk-soaked, crunchy and juicy to the bone

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the buttermilk and hot sauce. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours.
Whisk the flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper in a wide dish. Dredge the chicken and press the flour on.
Heat 1 inch of oil in a large deep skillet to 325°F.
Fry in batches, skin side down first, turning once, until deep golden.
Check that the thickest pieces read 165°F. Drain on a rack.
Rest the chicken for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken-fried steak with cream gravy
recipes.blurb: Crispy cube steak under peppery white gravy

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with 1/2 cup milk. Mix 1 cup flour with the salt and half the pepper in a dish.
Dip each steak in flour, then egg, then flour again, pressing firmly.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the steaks until deep golden on both sides, turning once. Move to a rack.
Pour off all but 1/4 cup of the oil. Whisk in 1/4 cup flour and cook until golden brown.
Whisk in 2 cups milk and the rest of the pepper. Simmer until thick.
Pour the gravy over the steaks and serve.

recipes.title: Smothered pork chops
recipes.blurb: Browned chops simmered in onion gravy until tender

steps.text: Mix the flour, paprika, salt and pepper in a dish. Coat the chops and shake off extra.
Brown the chops in hot oil in a large skillet, 3 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Cook the onion in the same skillet until soft and golden. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of leftover flour from the dish, then the broth. Stir until it thickens.
Nestle the chops back in the gravy, cover, and turn the heat to low.
Simmer until the chops reach 145°F and are tender.

recipes.title: Cornmeal fried catfish
recipes.blurb: Crisp cornmeal crust with flaky, mild fish

steps.text: Soak the fillets in the buttermilk.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper in a wide dish.
Heat 1 inch of oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Lift each fillet, let it drip, and press into the cornmeal mix to coat.
Fry in batches, turning once, until golden and flaking, 145°F inside.
Drain on a rack and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken and dumplings
recipes.blurb: Rolled biscuit dumplings in a rich chicken stew

steps.text: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large pot. Cook the onion, carrots and celery until softened.
Add the broth and chicken and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the chicken is 165°F. Shred it and return it to the pot.
Mix the flour, baking powder and salt. Cut in the cold butter, then stir in the milk to make a soft dough.
Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick and cut into 1-inch strips. Drop them into the simmering stew.
Cover and simmer until the dumplings are cooked through. Season with pepper.

recipes.title: Southern meatloaf with tangy glaze
recipes.blurb: Classic ground beef meatloaf with a ketchup-brown sugar top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Mix the beef, onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, eggs, milk, Worcestershire, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup ketchup.
Shape into a loaf on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Stir the remaining ketchup with the brown sugar and spread half over the loaf.
Bake for 40 minutes, then spread on the rest of the glaze.
Bake until the center reads 160°F.
Rest before slicing.

recipes.title: Shrimp and grits
recipes.blurb: Garlicky shrimp over creamy cheese grits

steps.text: Bring the water and 1 teaspoon salt to a boil. Whisk in the grits.
Turn to low, cover, and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the cheddar and butter. Keep covered.
Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp. Lift out, leaving the fat.
Cook the shrimp with paprika in the bacon fat until pink.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the lemon juice.
Spoon the grits into bowls, top with shrimp, bacon and scallions.

recipes.title: Fried green tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Tangy tomato slices in a crunchy cornmeal crust

steps.text: Salt the tomato slices lightly and lay them on paper towels.
Let the tomatoes drain, then pat dry.
Set up three dishes: flour; eggs mixed with buttermilk; cornmeal with salt and pepper.
Dredge each slice in flour, then egg, then cornmeal.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry in batches until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels.
Stir the mayonnaise and hot sauce together and serve for dipping.

recipes.title: Hoppin John
recipes.blurb: Black-eyed peas, rice and smoky ham, a New Year tradition

steps.text: Rinse the peas and pick out any stones. Soak them in water for 1 hour, then drain.
Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp. Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook until soft.
Stir in the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.
Add the peas, broth and ham hock. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer until the peas are tender.
Cook the rice separately by the package directions.
Pull the meat off the hock and stir it in. Season with salt and pepper and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken and sausage jambalaya
recipes.blurb: One-pot rice with andouille, chicken and the Cajun trinity

steps.text: Brown the sausage in oil in a large heavy pot, then lift it out.
Brown the chicken in the same pot for 5 minutes and lift it out.
Cook the onion, pepper and celery until soft. Add the garlic and Cajun seasoning.
Stir in the tomatoes, rice and broth. Add the meats back and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn to low, and cook without lifting the lid until the rice is tender.
Turn off the heat and let it steam. Stir in the scallions.

recipes.title: Shrimp etouffee
recipes.blurb: Shrimp smothered in a buttery roux sauce over rice

steps.text: Melt the butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Whisk in the flour.
Cook the roux, stirring constantly, until it is the color of peanut butter.
Add the onion, pepper and celery. Cook until soft, then stir in the garlic.
Whisk in the broth, tomatoes and Cajun seasoning.
Simmer the sauce until thickened.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and curled.
Stir in the scallions and spoon over rice.

recipes.title: Blackened catfish
recipes.blurb: Spice-crusted fish seared in a hot skillet

steps.text: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, cayenne, salt and pepper.
Pat the fish dry, brush with melted butter, and coat well with the spice mix.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat until very hot. Open a window and run the vent.
Sear the fillets until a dark crust forms.
Flip and cook until the fish is 145°F and flakes easily.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Shrimp creole
recipes.blurb: Shrimp in a spicy tomato and vegetable sauce over rice

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large skillet. Cook the onion, pepper and celery until soft.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Stir in the tomatoes, broth, Cajun seasoning and bay leaves.
Simmer, partly covered, until the sauce thickens.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink. Remove the bay leaves.
Serve over rice with scallions on top.

recipes.title: Cajun dirty rice
recipes.blurb: Rice cooked with seasoned ground meat and trinity vegetables

steps.text: Brown the sausage and beef in a large pot until no pink remains. Drain off extra fat.
Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook until soft. Stir in the garlic and Cajun seasoning.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute. Pour in the broth and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn to low, and cook until the rice is tender.
Rest, covered, then fluff with a fork.
Stir in the scallions.

recipes.title: Creamy Cajun chicken pasta
recipes.blurb: Spiced chicken and peppers in a cream sauce with penne

steps.text: Boil the pasta in salted water until tender, then drain.
Toss the chicken with 1 teaspoon Cajun seasoning.
Cook the chicken in oil until browned and 165°F inside. Lift it out.
Cook the pepper in the pan for 3 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the cream and the rest of the seasoning. Simmer until slightly thick.
Stir in the parmesan, chicken and pasta. Top with scallions.

recipes.title: Red beans and rice
recipes.blurb: Creamy slow-simmered kidney beans with smoked sausage

steps.text: Rinse the beans, cover with water and soak overnight. Drain.
Brown the sausage in oil in a big pot. Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook until soft.
Stir in the garlic, bay leaves and Cajun seasoning.
Add the beans and 7 cups water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer, partly covered, stirring now and then, until the beans are very tender.
Mash some beans against the pot to make it creamy. Remove the bay leaves, season, and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Blackened chicken breasts
recipes.blurb: Cajun-spiced chicken seared with a dark crust

steps.text: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, cayenne and salt.
Pat the chicken dry and coat both sides with the spice mix.
Heat the oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the chicken until a dark crust forms.
Flip and cook until the chicken reads 165°F.
Rest for a few minutes, then serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Cajun shrimp and sausage boil
recipes.blurb: Shrimp, sausage, corn and potatoes in spicy broth

steps.text: Bring the water, seasoning, lemon and garlic to a boil in a large pot.
Add the potatoes and boil until nearly tender.
Add the sausage and corn and boil.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink. Drain well.
Pour onto a newspaper-lined table, drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with seasoning.

recipes.title: Chicken and sausage gumbo
recipes.blurb: Dark roux gumbo with andouille and tender chicken

steps.text: Whisk the oil and flour in a Dutch oven over medium heat.
Cook the roux, stirring nonstop, until it is the color of chocolate.
Stir in the onion, pepper and celery. Cook until soft, then add the garlic.
Slowly stir in the broth. Add the chicken, sausage, seasoning and bay leaves.
Simmer, partly covered, until the chicken is 165°F and tender.
Shred the chicken, return it to the pot, and remove the bay leaves. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Brunswick stew
recipes.blurb: Smoky pulled meat, corn and beans in a tomato stew

steps.text: Cook the onion in oil in a large pot until soft.
Add the tomatoes, broth, barbecue sauce, Worcestershire and hot sauce.
Stir in the pork, chicken, corn and lima beans.
Bring to a boil, then turn down and simmer, stirring now and then, until thick.
Taste and add salt and pepper. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Texas beef chili (no beans)
recipes.blurb: Chunky beef in a deep red chile sauce

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in 2 tablespoons hot oil in a Dutch oven. Set aside.
Cook the onion in the last tablespoon of oil until soft. Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce, broth, beef and 1 teaspoon salt.
Cover and simmer on low until the beef is tender.
Stir the masa harina with 1/4 cup water and mix into the chili.
Simmer uncovered until thick. Add salt to taste.

recipes.title: Ham and bean soup
recipes.blurb: Navy beans simmered with a ham bone and vegetables

steps.text: Rinse the beans and soak them overnight in water. Drain.
Put the beans, ham bone, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, 8 cups water and bay leaves in a big pot.
Bring to a boil.
Turn to low, cover partly, and simmer until the beans are tender.
Pull out the bone, shred the meat and return it. Stir in the diced ham and pepper.
Simmer to heat the ham. Remove bay leaves, taste, and serve.

recipes.title: Southern beef stew
recipes.blurb: Beef, potatoes and carrots in a rich gravy

steps.text: Toss the beef with the flour, 1 teaspoon salt and some pepper.
Brown the beef in hot oil in a Dutch oven in batches. Set aside.
Cook the onion until soft. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the broth, Worcestershire and beef. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low until the beef is nearly tender.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Southern corn chowder
recipes.blurb: Creamy chowder with sweet corn, bacon and potatoes

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp. Lift out and keep 2 tablespoons of fat.
Cook the onion and celery in the fat until soft. Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Whisk in the broth. Add the potatoes and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Add the corn, milk and cream. Mash a few potatoes to thicken.
Simmer gently, do not boil. Season, and top with bacon.

recipes.title: Black-eyed pea and sausage soup
recipes.blurb: Hearty peas with smoked sausage and greens

steps.text: Brown the sausage in oil in a large pot. Lift it out.
Cook the onion and carrots until soft. Add the garlic and paprika.
Add the peas, broth and sausage. Bring to a boil.
Simmer to blend the flavors.
Stir in the greens and cook until tender.
Add the vinegar, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Baked mac and cheese
recipes.blurb: Creamy cheddar sauce under a crisp breadcrumb top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Butter a 9x13 baking dish.
Boil the macaroni in salted water 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain.
In the same pot, melt 4 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk. Keep stirring until it thickens.
Turn off the heat. Stir in 2 cups cheese, the salt and garlic powder, then the macaroni.
Pour into the dish. Top with the last cup of cheese, then breadcrumbs mixed with melted butter.
Bake until bubbly and golden on top.
Let it cool a few minutes before serving. It will be very hot.

recipes.title: Southern collard greens
recipes.blurb: Tender greens simmered low with smoked turkey and vinegar

steps.text: Wash the collards well in a sink of water, then drain.
Put the turkey wing, onion, garlic, broth and red pepper flakes in a large pot and bring to a boil.
Simmer the turkey to flavor the broth.
Add the collards in handfuls, stirring as they wilt.
Cover and simmer until very tender.
Stir in the vinegar, sugar and salt. Pull the meat off the wing, chop it, and stir it in.

recipes.title: Southern green beans with bacon
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked green beans in a smoky bacon broth

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
Cook the onion in the bacon fat until soft.
Add the beans, broth, sugar, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low until tender.
Stir the bacon back in and serve.

recipes.title: Candied yams
recipes.blurb: Sweet potatoes baked in a brown sugar, butter and cinnamon glaze

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Spread the sweet potatoes in a 9x13 baking dish.
Whisk the butter, brown sugar, water, cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla and salt. Pour over the potatoes.
Cover the dish tightly with foil.
Bake, covered.
Uncover and spoon the syrup over the potatoes.
Bake uncovered, basting once, until tender and glazed.

recipes.title: Creamy Southern coleslaw
recipes.blurb: Crunchy cabbage in a sweet-tangy dressing

steps.text: Put the cabbage and carrots in a large bowl.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard, celery seed, salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage and toss well.
Chill so the flavors blend and the cabbage softens.
Toss again, taste, and adjust the salt.

recipes.title: Southern potato salad
recipes.blurb: Creamy potato salad with eggs, pickle and mustard

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until just tender. Drain and cool.
Hard-boil the eggs in a separate pot, then cool in cold water.
Peel and chop the eggs.
Whisk the mayonnaise, mustard, relish, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Gently fold in the potatoes, eggs, celery and onion.
Chill. Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

recipes.title: Southern baked beans
recipes.blurb: Sweet and smoky beans baked with bacon and molasses

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Cook the bacon and onion in a skillet until the bacon is crisp and the onion soft.
Mix the beans, ketchup, sugar, molasses, mustard and Worcestershire in a 2-quart baking dish.
Stir in the bacon mixture.
Bake uncovered, stirring once, until thick and bubbling.
Let the beans rest to thicken before serving.

recipes.title: Creamy cheese grits
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked stone-ground grits with sharp cheddar

steps.text: Bring the water, milk and salt to a gentle boil.
Slowly whisk in the grits so no lumps form.
Turn to low, cover, and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the butter, then the cheese until melted.
Add pepper, taste for salt, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Cornmeal fried okra
recipes.blurb: Crispy golden okra bites with a cornmeal crust

steps.text: Toss the okra with the buttermilk in a bowl.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder in a bag or dish.
Lift the okra out with a slotted spoon, letting extra buttermilk drip, and toss in the cornmeal mix.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high until shimmering.
Fry in batches, turning, until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels, add a pinch of salt, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Buttermilk biscuits
recipes.blurb: Tall, flaky, buttery biscuits

steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar. Cut in the cold butter until pea-size pieces remain.
Stir in the buttermilk just until the dough comes together.
Pat the dough on a floured counter to 1 inch thick. Fold it in thirds twice, then pat out to 1 inch.
Cut with a floured 2.5-inch cutter, pushing straight down. Set the biscuits touching on the sheet.
Bake until tall and golden brown.
Brush the tops with melted butter.

recipes.title: Skillet buttermilk cornbread
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged cornbread baked in a hot cast-iron skillet

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet with 2 tablespoons butter inside to melt.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk and eggs, then stir into the dry mix. Add 2 tablespoons melted butter.
Swirl the hot skillet to coat, then pour in the batter. It should sizzle.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool a few minutes, then slice into wedges.

recipes.title: Hushpuppies
recipes.blurb: Crispy fried cornmeal balls with onion

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Stir in the onion, egg and buttermilk to make a thick batter.
Rest the batter.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a deep pot to 350°F.
Drop in rounded tablespoons of batter, a few at a time. Fry, turning, until deep golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.

recipes.title: Biscuits and sausage gravy
recipes.blurb: Fluffy biscuits under peppery sausage gravy

steps.text: Brown the sausage in a large skillet, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Sprinkle the flour over the sausage and stir for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, stirring. Simmer until thick.
Stir in the pepper, then taste and add salt.
Split the biscuits and ladle the gravy over them.

recipes.title: Cornbread muffins
recipes.blurb: Sweet-tender cornbread baked in a muffin tin

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the milk, egg and oil, then stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Divide the batter among the muffin cups, filling them two-thirds full.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Brush with honey and serve warm.

recipes.title: Easy cheddar drop biscuits
recipes.blurb: No-roll biscuits with sharp cheddar

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and garlic powder. Cut in the butter until crumbly.
Stir in the cheddar, then the buttermilk, just until combined.
Drop heaping 1/4-cup scoops of dough onto the sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake until golden brown on top.
Cool a couple of minutes and serve warm.

recipes.title: Jalapeno cheddar cornbread
recipes.blurb: Spicy, cheesy skillet cornbread

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven to heat.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter. Stir into the dry mix.
Fold in the cheddar and jalapenos.
Carefully spoon the batter into the hot greased skillet.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cheddar garlic biscuits
recipes.blurb: Buttery biscuits with a garlic butter brush

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and garlic powder. Cut in the cold butter until crumbly.
Stir in the cheddar and buttermilk to make a shaggy dough.
Pat the dough to 1 inch thick on a floured counter and cut 8 rounds.
Bake until golden.
Stir the melted butter with the garlic and parsley and brush over the hot biscuits.

recipes.title: Southern hoecakes
recipes.blurb: Pan-fried cornmeal cakes with crisp edges

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Stir in the buttermilk and egg until just mixed.
Let the batter rest to thicken.
Melt a little butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Spoon in 1/4-cup rounds. Cook until the edges are crisp and bubbles show, then flip and cook the other side.
Serve warm with butter or syrup.

recipes.title: Sweet potato biscuits
recipes.blurb: Soft, lightly sweet biscuits with a golden color

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt, brown sugar and cinnamon. Cut in the butter until crumbly.
Stir in the mashed sweet potato and milk until a soft dough forms.
Pat the dough 3/4 inch thick on a floured counter and cut with a 2-inch cutter.
Bake until puffed and golden brown on the bottoms.
Brush with honey while hot.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker Carolina pulled pork
recipes.blurb: Tangy vinegar-pepper pork, fall-apart tender

steps.text: Mix the brown sugar, paprika, salt, black pepper and garlic powder. Rub all over the pork.
Put the onion in the slow cooker and set the pork on top.
Stir 0.5 cup vinegar, the water and red pepper flakes together and pour around the pork.
Cover and cook on low until the pork shreds easily and reaches 200°F inside.
Lift the pork to a bowl and shred it, tossing out any big pieces of fat.
Stir in 0.5 cup of the cooking liquid and the rest of the vinegar. Taste and add salt.
Pile on buns with coleslaw mix.

recipes.title: Oven St. Louis-style ribs
recipes.blurb: Dry-rubbed, slow-baked and glazed until they sticky up

ingredients.item: racks St. Louis-style pork ribs (about 2.5 lb each)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 275°F. Peel the thin membrane off the back of each rack with a paper towel.
Mix the sugar, paprika, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and chili powder. Rub it on both sides.
Wrap each rack tightly in foil, meaty side up, and set on a rimmed baking sheet.
Bake until the meat is tender and pulls back from the bones.
Heat the broiler. Unwrap the ribs and brush the tops with barbecue sauce.
Broil 4 to 6 inches from the heat until the sauce bubbles and darkens, watching closely.
Rest the ribs, then slice between the bones.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker BBQ brisket
recipes.blurb: Sliced beef brisket in a sweet-smoky sauce, no smoker needed

steps.text: Rub the brisket with salt, pepper and paprika.
Sear the brisket in hot oil in a big skillet, 4 minutes per side. Move to the slow cooker.
Scatter the onion and garlic on top.
Whisk the barbecue sauce, broth, Worcestershire and vinegar. Pour over the brisket.
Cover and cook on low until fork-tender and 200°F inside.
Rest the brisket on a board, then slice against the grain.
Skim fat from the sauce, spoon it over the slices and serve.

recipes.title: Spatchcock barbecue chicken
recipes.blurb: Flat roast chicken, fast and juicy, lacquered with sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. With kitchen shears cut out the backbone, then press the chicken flat, skin up.
Mix paprika, salt, pepper, garlic powder and sugar. Pat the chicken dry, rub with oil, then the spices.
Roast on a rimmed baking sheet until the thigh reaches 150°F.
Brush the skin generously with barbecue sauce.
Roast until the thickest part of the thigh reaches 165°F and the sauce is tacky.
Rest the chicken, then carve.

recipes.title: Oven BBQ beef short ribs
recipes.blurb: Bone-in short ribs braised until the meat falls off

steps.text: Heat the oven to 325°F. Season the short ribs with salt and pepper.
Brown the ribs in hot oil in a Dutch oven, in batches, 3 minutes per side. Set aside.
Cook the onion in the drippings 4 minutes, add garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in barbecue sauce, broth and vinegar. Return the ribs, bone side up, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven until the meat is very tender.
Skim off fat, then simmer the sauce on the stove until slightly thick, about 5 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over the ribs and serve.

recipes.title: Smoked sausage and potato foil packs
recipes.blurb: Easy cookout dinner with barbecue-seasoned potatoes

steps.text: Heat the grill to medium, about 400°F. Tear off four 14-inch sheets of heavy foil.
Toss the sausage, potatoes, pepper and onion with oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Divide among the foil sheets and fold into sealed packets, leaving a little air space.
Grill with the lid closed, turning once, until the potatoes are tender.
Open carefully, steam will escape. Drizzle with barbecue sauce.
Serve straight from the foil.

recipes.title: Memphis dry-rub pork tenderloin
recipes.blurb: Sweet-smoky spice crust, roasted or grilled, sliced thin

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F, or the grill to medium-high. Trim the silver skin off the pork.
Mix sugar, paprika, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and mustard.
Rub the pork with oil, then press the spices all over.
Sear in an oven-safe skillet 2 minutes per side, then roast (or grill with the lid closed) until 145°F inside.
Rest the pork, then slice.
Serve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: Sticky oven BBQ chicken thighs
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged thighs glazed in sweet and tangy sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.
Pat the thighs dry. Toss with oil, paprika, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Roast skin side up until the skin starts to crisp.
Whisk the barbecue sauce, honey and vinegar. Brush half over the chicken.
Roast again until the thickest part is 175°F and the glaze is sticky.
Brush with the remaining sauce and serve.

recipes.title: BBQ pulled pork stuffed potatoes
recipes.blurb: Loaded baked potatoes piled with saucy pork

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Scrub the potatoes, prick with a fork, rub with oil and salt.
Bake directly on the oven rack until tender when pierced.
Warm the pork with the barbecue sauce in a saucepan until steaming hot, 165°F.
Split the potatoes and fluff the insides with a fork.
Top with pork and cheddar. Return to the oven 3 minutes to melt the cheese.
Finish with sour cream and green onions.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker country-style BBQ ribs
recipes.blurb: Meaty boneless ribs that come out spoon-tender

steps.text: Rub the ribs with paprika, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Layer the onion in the slow cooker and add the ribs.
Whisk 1 cup barbecue sauce with the water and brown sugar. Pour over the ribs.
Cover and cook on low until very tender and at least 195°F inside.
Heat the broiler. Move the ribs to a foil-lined pan and brush with the remaining sauce.
Broil until the sauce is bubbling and caramelized.
Serve with extra sauce from the cooker.

recipes.title: Oven BBQ turkey breast
recipes.blurb: Juicy sliced turkey with a sweet, smoky glaze

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Pat the turkey dry and rub with oil, paprika, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Set the turkey in a baking dish and roast uncovered.
Roast 50 minutes, then check the temperature.
Stir the barbecue sauce and honey. Brush half onto the turkey.
Roast until the thickest part reads 165°F, brushing once more halfway.
Rest the turkey, then slice and serve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: Grilled BBQ shrimp skewers
recipes.blurb: Quick smoky shrimp, brushed with sauce as they char

steps.text: Heat the grill to medium-high.
Toss the shrimp with oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Thread 5 or 6 onto each skewer.
Grill 2 minutes per side, then brush with barbecue sauce.
Grill 1 more minute per side until pink and opaque, 145°F inside.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Alabama white sauce chicken
recipes.blurb: Roasted chicken quarters with a peppery mayo-vinegar sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Pat the chicken dry and rub with oil, salt, 1 tsp pepper, garlic powder and paprika.
Roast on a rack set over a baking sheet until the skin is crisp and the thickest part is 175°F.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, horseradish, sugar, lemon juice and the remaining pepper.
Let the chicken rest 5 minutes.
Dunk or brush each quarter in about half the sauce and serve the rest alongside.

recipes.title: Oven chuck roast burnt ends
recipes.blurb: Cubed beef with caramelized edges, a brisket-tip stand-in

steps.text: Heat the oven to 275°F. Mix paprika, salt, pepper, garlic powder and sugar. Rub it on the chuck roast.
Roast uncovered on a rack in a roasting pan until it reaches 195°F inside and is tender.
Cut the beef into 1.5-inch cubes and put in a foil pan.
Add the barbecue sauce, honey, butter in pieces and broth. Toss to coat.
Bake uncovered at 275°F until the sauce is thick and the edges caramelize, stirring once.
Rest 10 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Nashville hot chicken
recipes.blurb: Crispy fried chicken brushed with cayenne-spiked oil

steps.text: Soak the chicken in buttermilk with 1 tsp salt in the fridge, at least 2 hours.
Whisk the flour, paprika, black pepper, garlic powder and 1 tsp salt. Dredge each piece twice, pressing firmly.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 325°F. Fry in batches, holding the oil near 300°F to 325°F.
Fry until deep golden and the thickest part reads 175°F.
Drain on a rack. Whisk 0.5 cup of the hot frying oil with the cayenne, sugar and chili powder.
Brush the spicy oil over the chicken. Serve on white bread with pickles.

recipes.title: Chicken and waffles
recipes.blurb: Crisp buttermilk chicken tenders on fluffy waffles with syrup

steps.text: Toss the chicken with buttermilk and 0.5 tsp salt. Marinate 30 minutes or up to 4 hours.
Whisk flour, paprika, garlic powder, pepper and 0.5 tsp salt. Dredge the chicken, pressing to coat.
Heat 1.5 inches of oil in a heavy skillet to 350°F.
Fry the tenders in batches until golden and 165°F inside.
Drain on a rack. Toast or cook the waffles.
Stack waffles with chicken. Top with butter and warm maple syrup.

recipes.title: Country-fried steak with onion gravy
recipes.blurb: Crisp cube steak smothered in browned onion gravy

steps.text: Mix 1 cup flour with 1.5 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper and the garlic powder. Beat the eggs with the milk.
Dredge each steak in flour, then egg, then flour again, pressing firmly.
Fry in 0.5 cup hot oil over medium-high, 4 minutes per side, until golden and 160°F inside. Hold warm.
Pour off all but 3 tbsp oil. Cook the onion 6 minutes until browned.
Stir in 3 tbsp flour for 1 minute, then whisk in broth and the remaining salt and pepper.
Simmer the gravy until thick.
Spoon over the steaks.

recipes.title: BBQ meatloaf
recipes.blurb: Tender meatloaf with a sticky barbecue sauce glaze

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Stir the breadcrumbs and milk together for 5 minutes.
Mix in the beef, onion, garlic, eggs, 0.5 cup barbecue sauce, Worcestershire, salt and pepper. Do not overmix.
Shape into a loaf on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 40 minutes.
Stir the remaining barbecue sauce with the ketchup and spread over the top.
Bake until the center reaches 160°F and the glaze is tacky.
Rest, then slice.

recipes.title: Smothered chicken thighs
recipes.blurb: Skillet-seared chicken simmered in rich onion gravy

steps.text: Season the chicken with 1 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp pepper and the paprika. Dust with 2 tbsp flour.
Sear in hot oil, skin side down first, until browned, 5 minutes per side. Set aside.
Cook the onion and pepper in the drippings 5 minutes. Add garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the remaining flour for 1 minute, then the broth, thyme and remaining salt and pepper.
Return the chicken, skin up, and cover.
Simmer on low until the chicken reaches 175°F and the gravy is thick.
Serve over rice or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Turkey pot pie with biscuit topping
recipes.blurb: Creamy turkey and vegetable filling under golden biscuits

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Melt the butter in a large oven-safe skillet and cook the onion and celery 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute. Whisk in broth and milk and simmer until thick.
Simmer, stirring often, until the sauce coats a spoon.
Stir in the turkey, peas and carrots, thyme, salt and pepper. Heat through.
Arrange the biscuits over the filling, edges touching.
Bake until the biscuits are deep golden and cooked through.
Cool a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Beef pot pie with flaky crust
recipes.blurb: Tender beef and potatoes in gravy under a puff of pastry

steps.text: Season the beef with salt and pepper. Brown in hot oil in a Dutch oven in two batches, then set aside.
Cook the onion and carrots 5 minutes. Stir in flour and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the broth and beef. Cover and simmer gently on low.
Simmer until the beef is nearly tender, adding the potatoes for the last 20 minutes.
Stir in the peas. Heat the oven to 400°F. Pour the filling into a 9x13 dish and cover with a crust, cutting vents.
Brush the crust with beaten egg.
Bake until the crust is golden and the filling bubbles.

recipes.title: Southern fried pork chops
recipes.blurb: Bone-in chops with a crunchy seasoned flour crust

steps.text: Soak the chops in buttermilk 30 minutes or up to 4 hours in the fridge.
Mix flour, salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder in a shallow dish.
Heat the oil in a large skillet to 350°F. Dredge each chop, shaking off extra.
Fry 5 minutes, flip, and fry until golden and 145°F inside. Work in batches.
Drain on a rack. Rest 3 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Buttermilk fried chicken tenders
recipes.blurb: Extra-crunchy tenders with a simple honey-mustard dip

steps.text: Toss the tenders with buttermilk and 1 tsp salt. Rest 20 minutes.
Whisk the flour, garlic powder, paprika, pepper and remaining salt. Dredge the tenders and press firmly.
Heat 1.5 inches of oil to 350°F.
Fry in batches until golden and 165°F inside.
Whisk mayonnaise, mustard and honey for the dip.
Drain the tenders on a rack and serve hot.

recipes.title: Southern chicken spaghetti
recipes.blurb: Creamy baked pasta with chicken, peppers and cheddar

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Boil the spaghetti 2 minutes short of the package time, then drain.
Melt the butter and cook the onion and pepper 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the soup, tomatoes, broth, salt, pepper and chicken. Fold in the spaghetti and 1 cup cheddar.
Spread in a greased 9x13 baking dish and top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake until bubbly and golden at the edges.
Rest before serving.

recipes.title: Hamburger steaks with brown onion gravy
recipes.blurb: Seared beef patties simmered in savory onion gravy

steps.text: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, salt, 0.5 tsp pepper and Worcestershire. Form four oval patties.
Sear in hot oil 4 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Melt the butter in the pan and cook the onion 6 minutes until browned.
Stir in the flour 1 minute, then whisk in the broth and remaining pepper.
Slide the patties back in. Cover and simmer on low until 160°F inside.
Simmer the patties in gravy.
Serve over mashed potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Cube steak and gravy over rice
recipes.blurb: Pan-fried cube steak smothered in peppery gravy

steps.text: Mix 0.5 cup flour with 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper and garlic powder. Coat the steaks.
Fry in hot oil 3 to 4 minutes per side until browned and 160°F inside. Set aside.
Whisk 3 tbsp flour into 3 tbsp of the pan oil and cook 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth and milk. Add the remaining salt and pepper.
Simmer until thickened.
Return the steaks to the gravy for 2 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Pecan-crusted catfish
recipes.blurb: Oven-crisp catfish fillets with a toasty nut crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F and grease a baking sheet.
Mix the pecans, breadcrumbs, salt, pepper and paprika. Stir in the melted butter.
Pat the fillets dry and brush with mustard. Press the crumb mix on top.
Bake until the crust is browned and the fish reaches 145°F.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Hot honey fried chicken
recipes.blurb: Golden buttermilk chicken drizzled with spicy honey

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in buttermilk and 1 tsp salt in the fridge for 2 to 12 hours.
Whisk the flour, paprika, garlic powder, pepper and remaining salt. Dredge each piece, pressing firmly.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 325°F. Fry in batches, keeping the oil 300°F to 325°F.
Fry until deep golden and dark meat is 175°F, white meat 165°F.
Warm the honey with the hot sauce and red pepper for 1 minute.
Drain the chicken on a rack, drizzle with hot honey and serve.

recipes.title: Sunday pork roast with onion gravy
recipes.blurb: Slow-roasted pork shoulder with potatoes and gravy

steps.text: Heat the oven to 325°F. Rub the pork with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Brown in hot oil in a Dutch oven, 4 minutes per side. Remove.
Layer the onions in the pot, set the pork on top and add the broth. Cover.
Roast 2 hours, then tuck the potatoes around the pork.
Cover and roast until the pork is fork-tender, about 195°F, and the potatoes are soft.
Move pork and potatoes to a platter. Whisk the flour with the water, stir into the pot juices and simmer 3 minutes.
Slice or pull the pork and serve with the gravy.

recipes.title: Chicken and dressing casserole
recipes.blurb: Cornbread stuffing layered with chicken and creamy gravy

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Melt the butter and cook the onion and celery 8 minutes.
Mix the cornbread, onion mixture, sage, salt and pepper. Whisk the eggs with 1.5 cups broth and stir in.
Spread half the dressing in a greased 9x13 dish. Top with the chicken.
Stir the soup with the last 0.5 cup broth and pour over the chicken. Cover with the remaining dressing.
Bake until golden on top and set in the middle, 165°F.
Rest before serving.

recipes.title: Baked pork chops and rice
recipes.blurb: Juicy chops nestled in seasoned rice, all in one dish

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Season the chops with half the salt, pepper and paprika.
Brown the chops in hot oil, 3 minutes per side.
In a 9x13 dish stir the rice, soup, broth, onion and the remaining salt and pepper.
Set the chops on the rice and cover tightly with foil.
Bake until the rice is tender and the pork reaches 145°F.
Rest 5 minutes, fluff the rice and serve.

recipes.title: Shrimp and andouille jambalaya
recipes.blurb: One-pot rice with smoky sausage, peppers and plump shrimp

steps.text: Brown the sausage in the oil in a Dutch oven, 4 minutes. Remove, leaving the fat.
Cook the onion, pepper and celery 6 minutes. Add garlic and Cajun seasoning for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, rice and broth. Return the sausage and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low, without lifting the lid, until the rice is nearly tender.
Nestle the shrimp into the rice, cover and cook until pink and 145°F.
Turn off the heat and let it steam.
Fluff with a fork and top with green onions.

recipes.title: Cajun sausage and rice skillet
recipes.blurb: Smoked sausage, peppers and rice in one skillet

steps.text: Brown the sausage in oil in a large deep skillet, 4 minutes.
Add the onion and pepper and cook 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and Cajun seasoning.
Stir in the rice, broth and tomatoes. Bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Rest, covered, then fluff.
Top with green onions.

recipes.title: Fried shrimp po’ boys
recipes.blurb: Cornmeal-crusted shrimp on crusty rolls with remoulade

steps.text: Soak the shrimp in the buttermilk 15 minutes.
Whisk the mayonnaise, Creole mustard and hot sauce for the sauce.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, Cajun seasoning and salt. Heat 1.5 inches of oil to 350°F.
Dredge the shrimp in the cornmeal mix, pressing to coat.
Fry in small batches until golden and 145°F inside. Drain on a rack.
Spread sauce on the rolls and pile in shrimp, lettuce and tomato.

recipes.title: Shrimp maque choux
recipes.blurb: Creamy skillet corn with bacon, peppers and shrimp

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large skillet until crisp, 6 minutes. Spoon out all but 1 tbsp fat.
Cook the onion and pepper in the bacon fat 5 minutes. Add garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the corn, tomatoes and Cajun seasoning.
Simmer until the corn is tender and the juices reduce.
Add the cream and shrimp. Cook until the shrimp are pink and 145°F.
Top with bacon and green onions.

recipes.title: Low-country boil
recipes.blurb: Shrimp, sausage, corn and potatoes in one big pot

steps.text: Fill a large stockpot with 4 quarts water. Add the lemon halves, Old Bay and salt.
Bring to a boil, add the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until almost tender.
Add the sausage and corn.
Boil until the potatoes are tender and the corn is bright.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and curled, 145°F. Drain.
Spread on newspaper-lined table. Serve with melted butter and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan Cajun chicken and potatoes
recipes.blurb: Spice-rubbed thighs roasted with crispy potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning.
Toss the potatoes, pepper and onion with the remaining oil, seasoning and salt on a large rimmed pan.
Nestle the chicken on top, skin side up.
Roast until the chicken is 175°F and the potatoes are golden.
Rest 5 minutes. Squeeze lemon over everything.

recipes.title: Cajun chicken fricassee
recipes.blurb: Chicken braised in a deep brown roux gravy over rice

ingredients.item: bone-in skin-on chicken thighs and drumsticks

steps.text: Season the chicken with the Cajun seasoning. Brown in a Dutch oven with 1 tbsp of the oil, 4 minutes per side. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil and flour. Stir constantly over medium-low heat until the roux is peanut-butter brown.
Stir the roux, keeping it moving so it does not burn.
Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook 5 minutes. Stir in garlic.
Whisk in the broth, return the chicken, and simmer covered.
Simmer until the chicken is 175°F and tender and the gravy has thickened.
Serve over rice with green onions.

recipes.title: Muffuletta sandwich
recipes.blurb: New Orleans stacked meats and cheese with olive salad

steps.text: Chop the olive salad and stir in 2 tbsp olive oil and the oregano.
Split the loaf and pull out some of the soft center. Brush both cut sides with remaining oil.
Spread half the olive salad on the bottom. Layer salami, ham, mortadella, provolone and Swiss.
Top with the remaining olive salad and the lid. Wrap tightly.
Press with a heavy pan in the fridge so the flavors blend.
Cut into wedges. Serve cold or warm in a 350°F oven for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cajun stuffed bell peppers
recipes.blurb: Peppers filled with spiced beef, sausage and rice

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Bring a pot of water to a boil.
Parboil the peppers until slightly softened, then drain and stand in a baking dish.
Brown the beef, sausage and onion in oil until the beef is no longer pink, 160°F, then add garlic and Cajun seasoning.
Stir in the tomatoes and rice. Spoon into the peppers.
Cover with foil and bake until the peppers are tender.
Top with cheese and bake until melted.

recipes.title: Smoked turkey and collard soup
recipes.blurb: Smoky broth with tender greens and white beans

ingredients.item: smoked turkey wings or legs (about 1.5 lb)

steps.text: Cook the onion and celery in oil in a Dutch oven for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the turkey and broth and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer until the turkey is very tender.
Lift out the turkey. Pull the meat off the bones and return it to the pot, discarding skin and bones.
Add the beans and collards.
Simmer until the collards are tender.
Stir in the salt, pepper and vinegar.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker pinto beans with ham hock
recipes.blurb: Creamy, smoky beans to ladle over cornbread

steps.text: Rinse the beans and pick out any stones. No soaking is needed.
Put the beans, ham hock, onion, garlic, water, chili powder and pepper in the slow cooker.
Cook on high until the beans are completely tender.
Lift out the hock, shred the meat and return it to the pot, discarding bone and skin.
Stir in the salt and vinegar. Mash some beans against the side to thicken.
Serve with cornbread and chopped onion.

recipes.title: Chicken bog
recipes.blurb: South Carolina rice and chicken pilaf with smoked sausage

steps.text: Put the chicken, onion, celery, broth, salt, pepper and paprika in a Dutch oven. Bring to a boil.
Simmer covered until the chicken is 175°F.
Lift out the chicken. Pull the meat off the bones and shred it.
Add the rice and sausage to the pot and bring back to a boil.
Cover and cook on low until the rice is tender and has soaked up the broth.
Stir in the chicken and rest 5 minutes. Top with green onions.

recipes.title: Shrimp and okra gumbo
recipes.blurb: Dark roux gumbo thickened with okra, loaded with shrimp

steps.text: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven. Whisk in the flour and stir constantly until the roux is the color of chocolate.
Stir the roux over medium-low, never walking away.
Add the onion, pepper and celery. Cook 5 minutes, then add the garlic.
Slowly whisk in the broth. Add okra, Cajun seasoning and bay leaves.
Simmer the gumbo, stirring now and then.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and 145°F, about 4 minutes. Remove the bay leaves.
Ladle over rice.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker brisket chili
recipes.blurb: Tender beef chunks in a smoky chili, loaded with toppings

steps.text: Brown the beef in the oil in batches, then move to the slow cooker.
Cook the onion in the same pan 4 minutes, add garlic and the spices for 30 seconds.
Add them to the slow cooker with the tomatoes, broth and salt.
Cover and cook on low until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the beans.
Cook 30 more minutes.
Serve topped with cheddar.

recipes.title: Smoked sausage and potato soup
recipes.blurb: Hearty creamy soup with smoky sausage and kale

steps.text: Brown the sausage in the oil in a Dutch oven, 4 minutes. Remove.
Cook the onion in the pot for 5 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the broth, potatoes, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Mash a few potatoes against the side of the pot to thicken.
Stir in the cream, sausage and kale. Simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern cornbread dressing
recipes.blurb: Moist, herby cornbread stuffing baked until golden

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Melt the butter and cook the onion and celery 8 minutes until soft.
In a large bowl, mix the cornbread, bread, onion mixture, sage, thyme, salt and pepper.
Stir in the broth and eggs until the mixture is very moist.
Spread in the dish and cover with foil.
Bake covered 25 minutes.
Uncover and bake until golden and set.

recipes.title: Skillet creamed corn
recipes.blurb: Sweet corn simmered in cream with a hint of bacon

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp, 6 minutes. Drain on paper towels, reserving 1 tbsp of fat.
Add the butter and corn to the fat and cook 5 minutes.
Sprinkle on the flour and stir 1 minute.
Add the cream, milk, sugar, salt and pepper.
Simmer until thick and creamy.
Top with the bacon.

recipes.title: Sweet potato casserole with pecans
recipes.blurb: Whipped sweet potatoes under a crunchy brown sugar topping

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Prick the potatoes and roast on a baking sheet.
Roast until very tender, then cool slightly.
Lower the oven to 350°F. Peel the potatoes and mash with melted butter, milk, 0.25 cup sugar, vanilla, cinnamon and salt.
Spread in a greased 8x8 dish.
Rub the flour, topping sugar, cold butter and pecans together with your fingers. Sprinkle over the top.
Bake until bubbly and the topping is browned.

recipes.title: Yellow squash casserole
recipes.blurb: Cheesy baked squash with a buttery cracker crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Simmer the squash and onion in 1 inch of water with 0.5 tsp salt until tender.
Simmer the squash.
Drain well, pressing out extra water, and mash lightly.
Stir in 1 cup cheddar, the egg, mayonnaise, pepper and remaining salt.
Spread in a greased 2-quart dish. Top with the remaining cheddar, then crackers tossed with the butter.
Bake until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Fried cabbage with bacon
recipes.blurb: Skillet cabbage browned in bacon fat until sweet and tender

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large deep skillet until crisp, 7 minutes. Move to a plate, leaving the fat.
Cook the onion in the fat 4 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the cabbage, salt, pepper and red pepper flakes.
Cook, stirring often, until tender and browned at the edges.
Stir in the vinegar and bacon.

recipes.title: Skillet bacon cornbread
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged cornbread baked in bacon drippings

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Cook the bacon in a 10-inch cast-iron skillet until crisp. Remove, leaving 2 tbsp fat.
Put the skillet in the oven to heat.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and butter, then stir into the dry mix with the bacon.
Pour into the hot skillet. It should sizzle.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cathead biscuits
recipes.blurb: Giant, fluffy drop biscuits the size of a cat’s head

steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F. Grease a 10-inch cast-iron skillet or baking pan.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Rub in the cold butter until pea-sized crumbs remain.
Stir in the buttermilk just until a shaggy dough forms.
Scoop six large mounds, about 0.5 cup each, into the pan so they touch.
Bake until tall and golden brown.
Brush with melted butter right away.
